Here are some of the books I have gotten that really help me. Obviously this are not necessary to be successful, but they are really great resources that I have been using.

Medical-Surgical Nursing Demystified, Second Edition by Mary Digiulio http://www.amazon.com/Medical-Surgical-Nursing-Demystified-Second-Edition/dp/0071771492

100% worth the price. Breaks down complication diseases and disorders and outlines the basics of pathophysiology, patient prognosis, the signs/symptoms, common test results, treatments, nursing diagnoses and interventions. The sections for each problem are know more than 3 pages and provides an amazing breakdown for students. I have only used the Med-Surg book, so I cannot speak to the others. I imagine them to be very useful as well.

Pharmacology Success: A Q&A Review Applying Critical Thinking to Test Taking by Ray A. Hargrove-Huttel RN PhD and Kathryn Cadenhead Colgrove RN MS CNS http://www.amazon.com/Pharmacology-Success-Applying-Critical-Thinking/dp/0803639058/ref=sr_1_1?s=books&ie=UTF8&qid=1435275022&sr=1-1&keywords=pharmacology+success

Med-Surg Success: A Q&A Review Applying Critical Thinking to Test Taking (Davis's Q&a Series) http://www.amazon.com/Med-Surg-Success-Applying-Critical-Thinking/dp/0803625049/ref=pd_bxgy_14_img_y

Both of these books are amazing in offering a wide variety of NCLEX style questions. These are broken down into body systems and make it easy to prepare for your exams while helping you adjust to the way NCLEX phrases the passages and sentences on their test. I use both these the night prior to my exam in order to prepare. Each book also comes with additional questions on the CD that are not included in the books. Amazing resources

I will continue to add books as I purchase them. Feel free to add any you have used and want to recommend.
